scope: Builds, validates, packs, and executes the first deterministic IQ2_XS routed-expert requantization using the RESMP-DEV standard 256x2048 iMatrix on Strix after the NVMe heatsink mitigation.

run_revision.remote_checkout_during_run: synchronized to bcb17c4293feb22845df0069781bcb93d72b4412 without touching the running ignored build

recipe.comparison: The byte representations differ because the committed generator regex-escapes dots; every entry in both files matches exactly one identical tensor name and no other name.

quantization.mode: COPY plus complete anchored per-tensor recipe; deterministic IQ2_XS expression; -ffp-contract=off
quantization.size_note: The standard-matrix artifact is 96 bytes larger than the earlier public-matrix artifact because its GGUF header/data-start is 352 bytes larger and tensor alignment differs. Tensor size and type contracts are unchanged.
quantization.wrapper_false_negative: The run wrapper required the old public artifact's 66649935616-byte size and wrote state=failed even though llama-quantize exited 0 with the valid 66649935712-byte standard artifact.

telemetry.post_smart: critical warning 0, 100% spare, zero media errors, zero error-log entries

tracked_reproduction.dry_run: PASS: 902 iMatrix entries, exactly 144 target conversions, zero unexpected conversions, 63551.82 MiB / 3.01 BPW

pack.mode: tools/iq_pack.py --compat-bf16 in an ephemeral uv environment with numpy, pyyaml, and regex

same_day_control.result: The standard artifact generated the same control token and was faster on this one-token gate.

non_claims: One greedy token proves loading and execution, not generation quality or general throughput.
No perplexity, task-quality score, long-generation comparison, or repeated throughput interval has run.
The full standard artifact has not been rebuilt on the Apple-silicon host, so cross-host whole-file reproducibility remains unproven.
The standard calibration matrix is not proven superior to the public matrix; only this one-token same-day control is recorded.
The artifact and pack remain local research outputs and are not setup choices or published artifacts.
The old public artifact's 24.96 tok/s control is same-day but not interleaved with the standard run; treat it as a control observation, not a confidence interval.
